facts.fact: The Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division keeps the civil status database that generates each citizen's unique identification number at birth registration.
The Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division operates a computerized system in all its Civil Status Offices for registering births, deaths and marriages.
The Pay Research Bureau report says deaths are registered in the Civil Status Division's computerized system in all its offices.
The Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division maintains a database generating a unique identification number for each citizen at the time of birth registration.

MUS.note: The document is about civil status, nothing on police stations.

facts.fact: The Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division monitors the Central Population Database holding basic information on all individuals registered in Mauritius and its Outer Islands.
The Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division operates a computerized system in all its Civil Status Offices for registering births, deaths and marriages.
The report says the computerized system runs in all Civil Status Offices, given as 44 sub offices in Mauritius, two in Rodrigues and one in Agalega.
